name: Nether Earth ZS Edition '98: the intro: robot
summary: The robot animation: its depacker and its four frames.

entries.name: RobotFrame
entries.summary: the robot's next animation frame from RobotStream

entries.name: RobotSelf
entries.summary: where RobotFrame goes on: the ROM's JP (HL) at $1FC8 lands here with HL = RobotSelf

labels.comment: A = 1: NZ for the ROM's RET Z
to $1FC6 in the 48 K ROM: POP HL / RET Z / JP (HL): back at RobotSelf with HL = RobotSelf
BC = the stream position (operand, RobotPos)
DE = RobotSelf
HL = RobotSelf + $2C8 = RobotStreamEnd - 1, the last byte of the stream
carry: the position is past it ...
... else go on from it
restart: RobotSelf + $B0 = RobotStream

labels.name: RobotStart
labels.comment: RobotSelf kept for the end
C = $F8: the mask of the address conversion
DE = the output position, from $4000

labels.name: RobotNext
labels.comment: the next code
$C0-$FF: the fills, literals and the end
$00-$7F: a copy
$80-$BF: a skip; $80-$83 with a byte, else code - $83

labels.name: RobotSkipLong
labels.comment: DE + (code & 3) * 256 + the next byte

labels.name: RobotCopy
labels.comment: HL = DE + the negative offset, B = the count; carry set (the copy mode)

labels.name: RobotCopyNext
labels.comment: a source byte: past $57FF as it is, else through the conversion
the screen address of HL into DE': H = H & $F8 | L & 7, L = (L & $F8 | H & 7) rotated left twice
the source byte

labels.name: RobotPut
labels.comment: a byte to the output: past $57FF as it is, else through the conversion
written

labels.name: RobotAdvance
labels.comment: the next position; carry: copy, zero: fill (the same byte), else a literal (the next byte)

labels.name: RobotFill
labels.comment: $C1-$FF: bit 0 of code - $C0 clear: literals (n / 2), set: fills

labels.name: RobotZeros
labels.comment: A = 0 (zero set, carry clear: the fill mode)

labels.name: RobotFillByte
labels.comment: the fill's byte

labels.name: RobotLiteral
labels.comment: n / 2 literal bytes (n = 0: the frame's end)

labels.name: RobotFrameEnd
labels.comment: $C0: the position after it into RobotPos

labels.name: RobotCopyAttr
labels.comment: a source byte past $57FF

labels.name: RobotPutAttr
labels.comment: a byte past $57FF: written as it is

labels.name: RobotStream
labels.comment: the four frames (src/res/intro98/robot.png, robot.parse)
